response.sql: WITH baseline AS (SELECT AVG(modelconf) as baseline_avg FROM compliancecase WHERE modelconf IS NOT NULL), status_groups AS (SELECT brokrepstat, AVG(modelconf) as status_avg FROM compliancecase WHERE modelconf IS NOT NULL GROUP BY brokrepstat), above_baseline AS (SELECT sg.brokrepstat, sg.status_avg, b.baseline_avg FROM status_groups sg CROSS JOIN baseline b WHERE sg.status_avg > b.baseline_avg), qualifying_mean AS (SELECT AVG(status_avg) as qm FROM above_baseline) SELECT ab.brokrepstat, ab.status_avg as average_modelconf, ab.status_avg - ab.baseline_avg as difference, ab.status_avg / qm.qm as ratio FROM above_baseline ab CROSS JOIN qualifying_mean qm WHERE ab.baseline_avg IS NOT NULL AND qm.qm IS NOT NULL

assumptions.assumption: Averages ignore missing values by excluding NULL modelconf values from baseline, group averages, and qualifying mean calculations
Return nothing (empty result) if baseline_avg is NULL or qualifying_mean is NULL
Rows with NULL brokrepstat form a single group representing cases with no broker reporting status

alternatives.interpretation: NULL brokrepstat values should be represented as a string like '(no status)' instead of JSON null for clarity
alternatives.sql: WITH baseline AS (SELECT AVG(modelconf) as baseline_avg FROM compliancecase WHERE modelconf IS NOT NULL), status_groups AS (SELECT brokrepstat, AVG(modelconf) as status_avg FROM compliancecase WHERE modelconf IS NOT NULL GROUP BY brokrepstat), above_baseline AS (SELECT sg.brokrepstat, sg.status_avg, b.baseline_avg FROM status_groups sg CROSS JOIN baseline b WHERE sg.status_avg > b.baseline_avg), qualifying_mean AS (SELECT AVG(status_avg) as qm FROM above_baseline) SELECT COALESCE(ab.brokrepstat, '(no status)') as brokrepstat, ab.status_avg as average_modelconf, ab.status_avg - ab.baseline_avg as difference, ab.status_avg / qm.qm as ratio FROM above_baseline ab CROSS JOIN qualifying_mean qm WHERE ab.baseline_avg IS NOT NULL AND qm.qm IS NOT NULL
